name: Deploy to Azure Container App (PRODUCTION)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - production   # Trigger only on merge/push to production
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY: animorhpayrolldev.azurecr.io
  CONTAINER_APP_NAME: ca-dev-payrollv2
  RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-payroll-dev
  IMAGE_NAME: payroll-api-prd
  NODE_ENV: production

jobs:
  build-test:
    name: Build & Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run tests
        run: yarn test

      - name: Archive test results
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: |
            coverage/
            test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-test
    environment:
      name: production      # 👈 triggers manual approval
      url: https://<your-production-url>   # optional link to app
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Login to ACR
        run: az acr login --name animorhpayrolldev

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=${{ github.run_number }}
          echo "IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          docker build \
            --build-arg NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV \
            -t $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG \
            -f Dockerfile .

      - name: Push image to ACR
        run: docker push $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

      - name: Deploy to Azure Container App (PRODUCTION)
        run: |
          az containerapp update \
            --name $CONTAINER_APP_NAME \
            --resource-group $RESOURCE_GROUP \
            --image $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: echo "🚀 Production deployed: $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}"
